items.title: Owls Look to Keep Rolling, Head West to Sam Houston
items.summary: Kennesaw State football looks to keep momentum as they travel to Sam Houston on Saturday, Nov. 14 at 2 p.m.

items.title: Grimes Named Conference USA Defensive Player of the Week
items.summary: KENNESAW, Ga. – Kennesaw State football junior defensive lineman Jaiden Grimes was honored for his performance in the Owls' 42-40 triumph over Delaware, being named Conference USA Defensive Player of the Week, the league announced Monday.

items.title: Kennesaw State Clips Fightin' Blue Hens, 42-40
items.summary: Kennesaw State rolled up 446 yards of offense to outduel Delaware, 42-40 on Saturday afternoon at Walens Family Field at Fifth Third Stadium.

items.title: Kennesaw State Athletics Provides Design Update on Wellstar Champions Complex
items.summary: KENNESAW, Ga. – Kennesaw State Athletics announced Wednesday that the schematic design phase has been completed for the Wellstar Champions Complex, the 55,000-square-foot future daily home for Kennesaw State football.
